verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents one built-in recurring automation: it can auto-create future Iterations and roll unfinished Stories into the next one, which is a narrow, fixed-purpose recurring schedule rather than general job scheduling. The API (shortcut-docs-1) is only a building block for automation and is not credited. Missing for 10: user-defined recurring schedules for arbitrary jobs or workflows, cron/cadence configuration docs, scheduled agent or automation runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: auto-create future Iterations, and move unfinished Stories to the next Iteration
